description: Derivation of stellar-pulsation response coefficient eta_P

geometric_contribution.source: Modified acoustic crossing time in disformal metric
geometric_contribution.derivation: Delta P/P = -epsilon/4 from r_tilde = (1+eps/2)r, c_s_tilde = c_s(1+3eps/4)

radiative_correction.source: Order-of-magnitude estimate from envelope sensitivity (NOT a computed eigenvalue result)
radiative_correction.note: A full LAWE eigenvalue calculation in the modified metric is required to compute delta_rad. The manuscript adopts eta_P = 1/2 (geometric) as the fiducial normalization.

eta_P.manuscript_adoption: eta_P = 1/2 (geometric fiducial); only the product eta_P * epsilon_0 is fixed by the fitted kappa_Cep

consistency_check.note: With the geometric fiducial eta_P = 1/2, the fitted kappa_Cep = 0.452e6 (redshift-only WLS) implies bar_epsilon_0 ~ 6.38e5 and epsilon_env ~ 0.064 (6.4%) at typical Cepheid locations (X_i ~ 1e-7), matching the manuscript value. The disformal coupling is a spatial distortion (not a frequency shift), so the relevant constraint is on stellar dynamics, not spectroscopic line shifts.
